bullets.text: A landslide known as the Ashfell Slide struck the mining region of Dreth in the early hours of 14 March 2026.
The slide damaged the lower road, and a warning was issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor as the risk to nearby settlements became apparent.
No casualties were reported within the first four hours; about 60 households were evacuated from Withel terraces and residents were moved out of Cranmoor.
Precautionary evacuations were under way at the end of the window, with the cause of the slide not yet addressed publicly.

A warning is issued for Withel terraces and Cranmoor about two and a half hours later.
About 60 households are evacuated from Withel terraces and people are moved out of Cranmoor.
Evacuation reports continue to circulate at the close of the window.
